name: Drift
bio: Photographer working in portrait, event, travel and nature photography.
artist_vibe_summary: Drift’s portfolio showcases a strong inclination toward travel and nature photography, featuring diverse outdoor scenes from dramatic golden-hour silhouettes and serene mountain lakes to moody, overcast landscapes. While the technical execution—including natural lighting, varied color grading ranging from warm tones to monochrome, and standard compositional framing—is generally sound, the work lacks a unified stylistic signature. The collection currently favors expansive landscapes and scenic geography over dedicated portrait or event studio work, indicating an emerging eye for environmental storytelling that would benefit from greater stylistic consistency.
